brand-deep.note: Text on soft fills, hover of the primary.

warm.note: Only for what needs attention now.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Cards and white controls on the lilac.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus; fields also get a 4px soft ring.

motion.name: ease-move
motion.purpose: --d-ease-move, small spring on entrances (menus, panes, toasts).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: Under 861 the sidebar becomes the top card (v28).

breakpoints.name: frame
breakpoints.note: From 1024 up: window-high frame, fixed title bar; under it controls are 44px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6a5cf5; color: #fff; font: 600 13px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3d2fc0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a4de0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White pill with the card shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #1d1840; font: 600 13px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #59547c 16%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(61,47,192,.06), 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(61,47,192,.22); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #59547c 30%, transparent); border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #1d1840; font: 500 13.5px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #6a5cf5 55%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, #6a5cf5 10%, #fff); outline: none; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White card on the lilac, 28px radius, no border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 28px; padding: 22px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(61,47,192,.06), 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(61,47,192,.22); color: #1d1840; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: #e1efff; color: #0e4d87; font: 600 12px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: White pill track with a sliding brand thumb.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(61,47,192,.06), 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(61,47,192,.22); } .ds-seg button { border: 0; background: none; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 13px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #59547c; } .ds-seg [aria-pressed=true] { background: #3d2fc0; color: #fff; }

components.name: Sidebar Card
components.description: Lilac card 224 wide (rail 68), current item white with brand-deep text.
components.css: .ds-side { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 224px; padding: 18px 12px; border-radius: 24px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #6a5cf5 9%, #f1effb); } .ds-side a { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 16px; color: #6d678f; font: 500 13.5px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-side [aria-current=page] { background: #fff; color: #3d2fc0; }

components.name: Right-side Drawer
components.description: All CRUD; slides in from the right with the spring, rounded on the left.
components.css: .ds-drawer { position: fixed; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; right: 0; width: min(520px, 100vw); background: #fff; border-radius: 28px 0 0 28px; box-shadow: -14px 0 40px -22px rgba(61,47,192,.4); }

narrative.overview: Direction D (artifact «Back office, direzione D» v28, approved 2026-10-14): a lilac canvas with white 28px cards and an indigo-tinted shadow, Bricolage Grotesque for titles and numbers, Figtree for the rest, one brand violet for action and selection and coral only for what needs attention now. Pages answer in words before numbers. Light only. Ships behind VITE_BACKOFFICE_D; with the switch off the previous system (The Quiet Operator) stays until a separate cleanup PR after PR 5.
keyCharacteristics: Lilac canvas, white cards at 28px, soft indigo shadow, no card borders.
Bricolage for titles and numbers, Figtree for everything else.
Brand violet for action and selection; coral only for 'look now'.
Pill controls 38px (44px under 1024), fields at 16px radius.
Spring on entrances, plain exits, reduced motion respected.

rules.name: The One Warm Rule
rules.body: Coral means 'this needs you now'; never decoration.

rules.name: The No-Color-On-Inactive Rule
rules.body: Resting chrome is ink and muted; saturation marks action, selection and state.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Bricolage only for titles and numbers; running text, labels and controls are Figtree.

rules.name: The Switch Rule
rules.body: Every D style sits inside @include look-d and every hex in _look-d.scss: with the switch off the app is unchanged.

dos: Compare each PR side by side with the v28 at 1440, 820 and 390.
Answer in words before numbers; body text at 4.5:1 or better.
Put all CRUD in the right-side drawer.
donts: No top navbar on desktop (the phone uses the v28 top card).
No coral or brand fill as decoration, no gradients on cards.
No third font, no Bricolage in running text.
No dark theme for D until it is designed.
